description: Compare the current window against a baseline window (the immediately preceding window of the same length) and detect anomalies across 4 axes: cost / latency / error_rate / call_volume — lets an AI grasp "is anything off?" in one prompt. Sensitivity is tunable via threshold: sensitive (1.5x) / normal (2x, default) / conservative (3x). 0-4 detections, each with a narrative. Returns { window, threshold, multiplier (the numeric factor behind threshold), current: {...}, baseline: {...}, anomalies: [{ axis, severity: 'minor'|'major'|'critical', current, baseline, ratio, narrative }], partialFailures?: string[] (axes that failed to fetch, as 'current:xxx' / 'baseline:xxx'; omitted when everything succeeds) }. errorRate is evaluated and displayed as a percent (0-100), matching the backend aggregate unit. Insufficient baseline data (fewer than 10 records in the period) yields anomalies: [] plus a warning message (this path omits multiplier; partialFailures is optional in the same way).
name: detect_anomaly
